item.title: An Evening With: Big Richard — Thu Oct 1, 7:30 PM
item.description:
Bluegrass band Big Richard makes music for the 21st century’s twisted cultural unease. Their latest album Pet, is a fierce, provocative, rejoinder to what troubles them and the world right now, which was recorded live to tape in order to capture the fervor of their live shows. Unapologetically outrageous and provocative, the band’s name is a wink to the ‘big dick’ energy Big Richard is reclaiming from male bluegrass bands. They’re intent on making audiences laugh and feel a little uncomfortable, for the sake of making them think, as well. To that end, the album’s cover portrays the band dressed in deranged clown outfits and crouching on railroad tracks in front of an oil refinery. And its title track “Pet,” delivered like a slightly demented circus sound track and written by Adams, is a rich paean for the people society too often lets fall through the cracks. Doors: 6:30 Show: 7:30 All Ages Tickets Now Available!
Source: The Mule at Devils Foot

item.description: Hendo Fun Friends **A Walk in the Park;** **Estatoe Trail;** from Lowes to Art Loeb Parking and back. Along the way, you'll travel through rhododendron tunnels, over boardwalks, and have lots of great views of the Davidson River. Heavily trafficked out and back trail. Difficulty: Suitable for beginners. A Sloth Walking Team event: A casual pace. **https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bf5TgVRGND4** The Curmudgeon will host. **Up to 12 ppl** are welcome to join us. **Hike Details:** Social ‘hour’ at 9:45 am; Sneakers leave at 9:55 am. item.title: Ashevillish Collab Release Party — Sat Oct 10, 12:00 PM
item.description:
We’re teaming up with our longtime friend Ryan of Ashevillish for a release that celebrates everything we love about this town! Over the past few years, Ryan has used his platform to shine a light on Asheville, introducing tens of thousands of followers to the small businesses, makers, and stories that make this place special. So when the opportunity arose to collab with Ryan, we couldn’t say no.
Come grab a can of the Blackberry Limeade collab, hang out, grab a bite from the food truck, dance to DJs spinning all afternoon, and watch live screen printing by Asheville Printing Company of Ashevillish limited edition shirts, made fresh on-site while you wait.
And, of course, in true community fashion, a portion of proceeds from this collab supports Asheville City Schools, Ryan’s own alma mater, a small way of investing back into the community that raised him, and that he’s spent years showing up for.
Source: The Mule at Devils Foot

item.title: Bears Den: Chicago Bears Watch Party — Sun Oct 11, 4:00 PM
item.description:
It’s the Crosstown Showdown for Bears @ Packers! That’s right, Chicago fans! We’re playfully teaming up with our friends at Foggy Mountain to show those Cheeseheads what true fandom looks like 😉 Fans of the Bears, come our way to be surrounded by fellow Shuffle enthusiasts. Packers fans, head to Foggy Mountain and enjoy whatever it is you guys do (and, admittedly, the best wings in town). We’ll both run raffles giving fans of each team a chance to win a gift card to either The Mule or Foggy Mountain – all depends on who takes the game! Drink specials. Food truck. Football on the big screen. Bear Down.
Source: The Mule at Devils Foot
